notes: Fiscal-year labeling: historical keys use the fiscal year end year (2023=year ended Dec 30, 2023; 2024=Dec 28, 2024; 2025=Dec 27, 2025). ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))

NWC definition used for this package (consistent across years): NWC = (Accounts receivable + Inventories + Prepaid expenses and other) − (Accounts payable + Payroll and related + Taxes + Other accrued). Cash and debt items (cash, bank credit lines, current maturities of long-term debt) and operating lease liabilities are excluded. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))

D&A used for historical base-case driver is the income-statement line 'Depreciation and amortization' (not a cash-flow 'D&A including other non-cash adjustments' line). ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))

Capex is modeled as absolute 'Purchases of property and equipment' from the cash-flow statement. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))

WACC (0.0885) and terminal growth (0.02) are assumed model inputs rather than explicitly disclosed in the filings; update them if your framework uses different discount-rate methodology. ([investor.henryschein.com](https://investor.henryschein.com/news-releases/news-release-details/2026/Henry-Schein-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results-and-Introduces-2026-Financial-Guidance))

NOL utilization percent (0.80) is an assumption because carryforward balances are disclosed, but utilization is not specified as a single deterministic percent in the sources retrieved here. NOL balances are the sum of federal, state, and foreign NOL carryforwards (~$514M). ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))
Comps: EV/NTM Revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, and P/E NTM were not reliably captured from primary sources in this run; fields are left null and should be populated from your market-data terminal.

catalysts: Outperformance of 2026 sales growth (upper end of 3% to 5%) and/or operating leverage from mix and cost discipline. ([investor.henryschein.com](https://investor.henryschein.com/news-releases/news-release-details/2026/Henry-Schein-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results-and-Introduces-2026-Financial-Guidance))

Progress on strategic initiatives supporting sustained technology and value-added services growth (reflected in base-case growth/margin durability). ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))
company_overview: Henry Schein is a solutions company providing health care products and value-added services to office-based dental and medical practitioners, plus technology/practice solutions. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))

Operating structure is reported across Global Distribution and Value-Added Services, Global Specialty Products, and Global Technology. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/2242bcce-0d9c-4adc-96eb-51e6356be30e.pdf))

In FY2025 (fiscal year ended Dec 27, 2025), Henry Schein generated net sales of $13.184B and operating income (EBIT) of $0.653B (~5% operating margin). ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))
current_context: On Feb 24, 2026, Henry Schein reported Q4 2025 GAAP diluted EPS of $0.85 and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.34. ([investor.henryschein.com](https://investor.henryschein.com/news-releases/news-release-details/2026/Henry-Schein-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results-and-Introduces-2026-Financial-Guidance))

The same release guided 2026 non-GAAP diluted EPS to $5.23 to $5.37, and guided total sales growth of 3% to 5%. ([investor.henryschein.com](https://investor.henryschein.com/news-releases/news-release-details/2026/Henry-Schein-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results-and-Introduces-2026-Financial-Guidance))
investment_highlights: Base case revenue growth ramps modestly from 2026 with a 5-year low-to-mid single digit profile consistent with disclosed 2026 sales growth guidance. ([investor.henryschein.com](https://investor.henryschein.com/news-releases/news-release-details/2026/Henry-Schein-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results-and-Introduces-2026-Financial-Guidance))

EBIT margin is modeled as stable-to-slightly-improving versus FY2023-2025 history (~0.049-0.050). ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))

Reinvestment intensity is kept around recent levels: capex modeled near ~1.1% of sales, aligned to FY2023-2025 capex trends. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))

Working capital intensity is normalized in the base case to a mid-teens percentage of sales based on FY2023-2025 year-end NWC calculations. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0001000228/3d18b79e-7336-427b-a014-a6076e5903d1.pdf))
key_risks: Demand or pricing pressure in dental/medical distribution could reduce sales growth and margins versus the base case.
Execution risks (integrations, technology rollout, cyber/data-security incidents) could increase costs and disrupt cash conversion.
